criteria.text: there is an alert rule on stock with 5 as the threshold

criteria.text: the plan is said in plain words before anything is built, with no field names or types

criteria.text: ends by asking whether to build

must_not.evidence: No field is written into products. The Stock section reads from inventory_levels; the rule only checks and alerts, does not set fields on products.

must_not.evidence: The alert rule uses the app's native alert mechanism ('alerts "Low stock"'), not email or external messaging the app cannot send.

transcript.text: tell me when any product's stock goes below 5

Main karunga: jab bhi kisi variant ka ek location par available stock 5 se neeche jaayega, alert milega — product, variant aur location naam ke saath (kyunki Silk Saree Main warehouse mein 0 hai par Mumbai store mein 2, ye alag-alag batana zaroori hai). 'Not tracked' variants ko chhod dunga, unka zero asli shortage nahi hota. Ek behtar idea: flat 5 ke bajaye har product ki apni sales speed ke hisaab se alert line rakhein — Brass Diya Set jaisa fast-seller zyada pehle, slow mover kam pehle alert kare. Chahiye ye behtar tarika, ya seedha flat 5 pe hi rakhun? Build kar doon?
Just flat 5 for everything, keep it simple. And yes, tell me each location separately—that part's good. Don't overthink it.

A Stock section will show every variant at every location, flag anything under 5 as Low, and will tell you the moment it crosses that line, naming the product, variant and location.
A Stock section over your Shopify stock levels, flagging any product variant with fewer than 5 available at a location, with an alert that names the product, variant and location each time it crosses that line.
